scripts.setup: npm install && npm run postinstall && npm run setup:env && bash scripts/db.sh
scripts.setup:env: for app in home william marc bolton leo george james conner robert harris cole johnny; do test -f apps/$app/.env.local || cp apps/$app/.env.example apps/$app/.env.local; done
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -k -n home,bolton,leo,marc -c cyan,blue,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:home" "npm run dev:bolton" "npm run dev:leo" "npm run dev:marc"
scripts.dev:extended: concurrently -k -n home,bolton,leo,marc,william,george -c cyan,blue,yellow,magenta,green,red "npm run dev:home" "npm run dev:bolton" "npm run dev:leo" "npm run dev:marc" "npm run dev:william" "npm run dev:george"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n home,william,marc,bolton,james,george,conner,robert,harris,cole,johnny,leo -c cyan,green,magenta,blue,white,red,brightRed,white,gray,brightCyan,white,yellow "npm run dev:home" "npm run dev:william" "npm run dev:marc" "npm run dev:bolton" "npm run dev:james" "npm run dev:george" "npm run dev:conner" "npm run dev:robert" "npm run dev:harris" "npm run dev:cole" "npm run dev:johnny" "npm run dev:leo"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @11am/home && npm run build -w @11am/william && npm run build -w @11am/marc && npm run build -w @11am/bolton && npm run build -w @11am/james && npm run build -w @11am/leo && npm run build -w @11am/george && npm run build -w @11am/conner && npm run build -w @11am/robert && npm run build -w @11am/harris && npm run build -w @11am/cole && npm run build -w @11am/johnny
